description: Phase FRP-7 V1.5 primary metric (supplement §22.1). Asserts that wizard.start → operator-record-persisted completes in ≤ 10 minutes under the rig's accelerated clock. Drives the FRP-5 wizard against a synthetic Hetzner provider mock + the FRP-4b BindAndSign codepath, then asserts the resulting OperatorRecord JSON is on disk and the V002 signed_sbp_* projection columns are populated. Recovery action on miss: re-run with a fresh ephemeral SSH key (the V1.5 provisioning path is idempotent on rerun).
